hero_title: Your Community. Your Services. Your Platform.
hero_subtitle: Connect with trusted local service providers. Book cleaning, repairs, tutoring, and more — all powered by a cooperative where workers own the platform.
feature_1_desc: Providers earn equity shares with every job. They own the platform they work on.

feature_3_desc: Your society books together and saves together. Up to 30% discount.

feature_6_desc: Refer your community and earn cashback on every booking they make.
